item.title: Command Responsibility at Home: Governors, the Guard, and Domestic Readiness

item.title: Beyond the Missile: A Cost-Per-Effect Blueprint for the Future Force
item.description: Should the United States buy more destroyers, or would the money be better spent developing bases, munitions, or software?
